# FoXYiZ/f — engine folder
#
# Keep:
#   FoXYiZ.exe     frozen Run engine
#   _internal/     required runtime next to the exe (do not delete)
#   fStart/        which suite + tags to run
#   .env.example   → copy to .env for optional BRAHL AI (local)
#
# Do not edit FoXYiZ.exe or _internal/. Architects ship a new User zip for engine changes.
#
# AI is optional. FoXYiZ Run / Loop / Verify never need a key.
# BRAHL Arena AI (Build / Analyze / Heal chat) reads FoXYiZ/f/.env when present.
#
# See: ../../_Docs/FoXYiZ.md  and  ../../_Docs/BRAHL.md
